title: German FCR capacity auction results (4-hour blocks).
source: regelleistung.net (German TSOs) data center, crds API v2
licence: proprietary (copyright German TSOs; reproduction needs prior written consent)
attribution: 50Hertz, Amprion, TenneT TSO, TransnetBW via regelleistung.net
transformation_notes: FCR capacity results (D-1 auction, 4-hour blocks NEGPOS_hh_hh in Europe/Berlin local time). price_eur_per_mw_h = GERMANY_SETTLEMENTCAPACITY_PRICE_[EUR/MW] divided by the block length in hours (3 or 5 hours on DST-change days); FCR clears at a uniform price, so marginal = settlement price. volume_mw = GERMANY_DEMAND_[MW]. direction = symmetric.
fcr_capacity_by_country.parquet (local only) keeps all FCR-cooperation countries incl. BELGIUM.
note: Not redistributed (regelleistung.net terms require prior written consent for reproduction). rows/sha256 describe the locally built file at retrieval time; rebuild with the fetch command.
